name: Riverton Rent Stabilization Ordinance
stated_aim: protect sitting tenants from rising rents

source_sentences: Rent on residential rental units existing on the effective date is frozen at its level on the effective date for 3 years; increases are capped at 2% a year after that.
Tenancies cannot be assigned or sold.

unclear.text: Whether major renovations allow a rent increase.

context: Market rents have risen about 5% a year for several years (WE-001 record).
Eastfield and Northgate are 15 to 25 minutes away by car or train and have no rent regulation (WE-001 record).
